description: An Android activity class (EditorActivity) that allows creating and editing notes. It manages UI components, loads existing notes if editing, and saves notes asynchronously to a repository.

classes.name: EditorActivity
classes.description: An activity providing UI for creating or editing notes, with data persistence managed asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, sets up toolbar, loads note if editing.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation when the up button is pressed.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, particularly save action.

methods.name: loadNote
methods.description: Loads a note from repository asynchronously and populates UI.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Validates input and saves the note (insert or update) asynchronously.

methods.name: loadNote
methods.description: Loads note data asynchronously from repository.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves note data asynchronously, either by inserting or updating.
